basic_details.job_title: Kamdhenu University Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Kamdhenu University has announced 1 vacancy for the Research Associate post on a contract basis for Anand. Candidates must possess a Ph.D. or Master's degree in specified disciplines, with pay ranging from Rs. 61,000 to Rs. 67,000 per month plus HRA depending on qualification. The appointment is purely contractual and will not provide employment after the research scheme. Eligible candidates must apply offline by sending the application on plain paper with bio-data, cover letter, and certified document copies via Speed Post or RPAD to the Professor and Head, Dept. of Veterinary Biotechnology,

how_to_apply: Prepare your application on plain paper along with a complete bio-data in the given format.
Enclose a cover letter clearly indicating the "Title of Post" and "Title of Project" for which you are applying.
Attach certified copies of all relevant documents chronologically.
Send the application via Speed Post or RPAD to the Professor and Head, Dept. of Veterinary Biotechnology, College of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry, Kamdhenu University, Anand – 388 001.
Ensure the application reaches on or before 30/10/2026.

content_sections.heading: Kamdhenu University Research Associate at a Glance

rows.details: Dept. of Veterinary Biotechnology, College of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry, Anand
Establishment of Panchagavya Research Centre at Kamdhenu University (B.H. 0105010221)
Rs. 61,000/- per month + HRA (for Master's degree & 2 yrs exp or Ph.D.) or Rs. 67,000/- per month + HRA (for Ph.D.)
Max. 40 years for Male & 45 years for Female

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Research Associate post must meet the prescribed educational qualifications and age limits.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D. in Biotechnology / Veterinary Medicine / Veterinary Pharmacology / Microbiology / Biochemistry / Life Sciences / Bio-informatics / Biomedical Science / Nutrition / Dairy Science & Technology OR Master's degree in Biotechnology / Veterinary Medicine / Veterinary Pharmacology / Microbiology / Biochemistry / Life Sciences / Genetics / Forensic Science / Bio-informatics / Biomedical Science / Nutrition / Dairy Science & Technology with 4/5 yrs of Bachelor's degree having 60% marks or equivalent grade point average with at least 3 years' experience and one research paper (SCI)/NASS rated (≥4.0) journal.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position offers a fellowship amount of Rs. 61,000/- per month plus HRA for candidates with a Master's degree and at least 3 years of experience, or for candidates with a Ph.D. Candidates with a Ph.D. can also receive Rs. 67,000/- per month plus HRA. The appointment is purely on a contractual basis under the research scheme "Establishment of Panchagavya Research Centre" and does not provide employment after the completion of the scheme.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kamdhenu University Research Associate
content_sections.text: Prepare your application on plain paper along with a complete bio-data in the given format. Enclose a cover letter clearly indicating the "Title of Post" and "Title of Project" for which you are applying. Attach certified copies of all relevant documents chronologically. Send the application via Speed Post or RPAD to the Professor and Head, Dept. of Veterinary Biotechnology, College of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry, Kamdhenu University, Anand – 388 001. Ensure the application reaches on or before 30/10/2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the review of applications. If the number of candidates is more, a written test will be conducted, followed by an interview. Original documents must be brought at the time of the interview. No TA/DA or any expenses will be given for attending the interview.
